biggest_catch: Only adults 70+ who pass medical screening qualify; the study requires three baseline clinic visits plus ongoing annual follow-ups, an MRI scan, and tissue collection, with the $450 paid only for full completion.
catches: Must pass medical screening; not everyone qualifies
Observational aging study: no investigational drug benefit; procedures include an MRI scan and tissue collection (muscle biopsy) with associated discomfort and small medical risks
70+ age requirement only; must be able to attend clinic visits in person
Long-term commitment: three baseline visits plus six-month phone contacts and annual follow-up visits
Up to $450 is a cap for full completion; partial participation pays less
Location-specific: AdventHealth Research Institute clinic site

eligibility: 70 years of age or older; able to attend clinic visits; willing to have an MRI scan; must pass medical screening; not everyone qualifies.
notes: One provider = one route. This route anchors on the AdventHealth Research Institute SOMMA study. Other AdventHealth studies are separate studies under the same provider route.

steps: Open the official study page at https://adventhealth.com/institutes/research/participate-somma-research-study
Confirm eligibility: 70 years of age or older, able to attend clinic visits, willing to have an MRI scan
Contact the AdventHealth Research Institute to express interest and schedule screening
Complete medical screening and informed consent before any procedure
Complete the three baseline visits (exams, vision/physical/cognitive tests, MRI, tissue collection)
Complete the six-month phone contacts and annual follow-up visits as scheduled
timing: Three baseline visits, six-month phone contacts, and annual follow-up visits; active on-site time estimated 480-720 minutes excluding travel and waiting.
